memoryFailure.finding: P2 Darwin child-exit/RSS sampling race misclassifies memory limit as INTERNAL_ERROR

forcedRealExitWindow.control: Block only parent event-loop delivery during a real libproc sample until the real allocation worker exits. No fake syscall result, exit status, worker frames or database result.

experimentalMinimalRepair.adapter: Translate only actual observed kernel ESRCH to ProcessLookupError, letting existing coordinator OSError branch reconcile actual exit through EOF/process.wait.

memoryFailure.recommendation: Preserve process-gone ESRCH separately from a live-process guard failure. Clear ctypes errno before proc_pidinfo and only classify nonpositive result with actual ESRCH as process gone. Parent then reconciles actual owned child exit; other native guard failure remains fail closed. Do not catch-and-ignore every MemoryGuardUnavailable and do not weaken test expectation.
memoryFailure.stderr: Production worker stderr remains DEVNULL. Diagnosis captured only exception type, native errno, actual owned child pid/returncode and synthetic SQLite job DTOs via an independent adapter.
memoryFailure.limitation: The ESRCH adapter validates a repair hypothesis, not an integrated candidate fix. Candidate implementation and a regression preserving non-ESRCH fail-closed behavior still required.

memoryProductionReview.sourceState: Rootnext uncommitted production fix on 7e58f08; source hashes identify exact reviewed bytes.
review: Library initialization precedes clear errno; proc_pidinfo result must be nonpositive and actual errno ESRCH to classify ProcessLookupError. Positive short result, stale ESRCH, EACCES, and absent native errno remain MemoryGuardUnavailable.
Coordinator catches only ProcessLookupError, then owned process EOF and controlled wait preserve actual 74 memory classification. Other native errors are not silently ignored.
Worker self-monitor handles guard-unavailable and OSError with fixed exit 75; MemoryError still fixed exit 74. No raw diagnostics cross boundary.

New actual-worker test holds only parent scheduling at native sample, asserts errno ESRCH with pending asyncio returncode, eventual actual 74, failed job/no result/no operation and unrelated project success.

progressIndependentReview.result: No new blocking finding in reviewed UI/buffer and producer progress deltas.
uiReview: Buffer stores at most sixteen entries and compact primitive identity/version fields plus a cloned finite ProgressView. No durable job DTO copy.
Progress becomes restored display only when generation, project, job membership, input snapshot, durable stateVersion and nonterminal state match authority; cloning prevents mutable aliasing.
Same-authority explicit refresh keeps stage; generation change, disconnect, newer state/terminal and unmount clear relevant progress. Older UI generation is rejected before remembering.

The live display path relies on TaskService current-watch DTO binding; receive already rejects terminal binding and project/session/subscription mismatches. Future progress waits for a matching authority view.
Unknown total remains null/null and actual DOM displays stage text only, without percentage.
producerReview: Stage is retained only in bounded active jobs; terminal notify and final active cleanup remove it. Stage changes and a single late-subscription snapshot emit hints; no timer broadcast added.
New subscription response copies seq0 before synchronous targeted snapshot seq1. Existing subscriptions do not consume that new snapshot; state/progress use one monotonic binding sequence.
Progress uses current durable nonterminal stateVersion without changing SQLite job state. Cancellation emits state first and maps subsequent stage to reconciling.
Round commit, final commit, process wait and cancellation still use existing controlled deadlines and commit-boundary checks. Progress adds no worker, retry or commit replay.
Six tests cover actual worker read/atomic/round stage sequences, failure cleanup, raw stdio early snapshot and nonperiodic delivery, unsubscribe isolation, cancellation and a second real job.
